consequence: Sampling stays exactly as Gen44 pinned it: temperature 0.6, top_p 0.8, top_k 20, min_p 0. The three repetitions per cell are stochastic SAMPLES, not reproductions, and every comparison in this report is read that way.
evidence: Pi 0.73.0 ProviderConfig and ProviderModelConfig expose api, baseUrl, reasoning, thinkingLevelMap, input, cost, contextWindow and maxTokens; there is no sampling block and no seed field.
SimpleStreamOptions extends StreamOptions with reasoning and thinkingBudgets only.
The only 'seed' strings in @mariozechner/pi-ai are model identifiers such as bytedance-seed/seed-1.6, not a request parameter.

The one injection point is before_provider_request, whose handler replaces the outgoing payload. Using it would put an extension in front of arm A's requests, and arm A is defined as stock Pi with nothing in front of the request.
